name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefit_summary: Monthly social pension of ₹200–₹500 from Central Govt plus State top-ups (totaling ₹1,000 to ₹3,000/month depending on State) for elderly citizens living below poverty line.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) guidelines.
required_documents: Proof of Age (Voter ID or Birth Certificate)
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
